title: High-Tech IoT Aeroponics & Carolina Reaper Lab
summary: Automated indoor aeroponic cultivation chamber engineered for Carolina Reaper peppers, featuring ultrasonic misting, custom liquid Peltier chillers, and closed-loop microcontroller environmental telemetry.
highlights: Cultivated imported Carolina Reaper chili peppers using soil-less ultrasonic high-frequency mist atomization.
Engineered custom nutrient chiller combining Peltier thermoelectric plates with PC CPU liquid cooling waterblocks.
Automated photoperiod and closed-loop environmental controls (temperature, pH, humidity) with Arduino and SBC relays.
